scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
A human?!
This land is full
of your kind. What
brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
人類？！
這片土地上到處都是你們這種人。
你們來這裡幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
離開家鄉，生活在米德加爾特已經夠痛苦了，還要面對你們這些愛抱怨的人類。別來煩我！

scripts.text: Ask him about Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於矮人的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he is doing.
scripts.translation: 詢問他在做什麼

scripts.text: Request weapon creation.
scripts.translation: 請求打造武器

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
What's to know about Dwarves?
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
how harsh the environment may be.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
矮人有什麼好了解的？
我們是最強壯的種族。畢竟，無論環境多麼惡劣，我們都能在任何地方生存。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
Try to imagine.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我懷疑你那脆弱的頭腦無法理解，生活在我的故土對你們來說是多麼難以忍受，但你可以試著想像一下。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你們人類引以為傲的大部分知識和技能，很可能都是矮人傳授給你們的。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
尤其是在鍛造方面。就連眾神的工具和武器，也是由我的祖先打造的。你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我們擁有最淵博的知識和技藝，卻不得不接受命運，生活在巨人那片寒冷貧瘠的土地上。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
here so I can kick their ass!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你剛才問我在這裡做什麼嗎？哇哈哈！我在等那些愚蠢到敢來這裡的人類，好痛扁他們一頓！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
each other.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
哦，別擔心。和你這種弱者打架只會讓我自降身份。人類雖然脆弱，卻固執地抱著傲慢不放，還互相爭鬥。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
作為一個種族，你們簡直無可救藥。我甚至不願和人類生活在同一片大陸上！但唉，我別無選擇。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
The path to my hometown
disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
一千年前的那場戰爭之後，通往我家鄉的道路消失了。不知為何，我再也無法找到通過世界樹回到那裡的路...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'm stuck here in Midgard.
At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我困在米德加爾特了。
至少我有幸找到了這個洞穴。畢竟，矮人在地下生活最舒適了。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
我需要一些材料才能為你打造武器。你具體想要什麼？

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神項鍊

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰帶

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼爾之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之錘

[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold^000000
1 Necklace^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF4個芙蕾雅寶石
4個銀飾品
3個雪的結晶
3個漣漪
3個空氣雕像
2個藍寶石
3個珍珠
10個蛋白石
5個詛咒紅寶石
20個金塊^000000
1個項鍊^000000...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
不過，打造女神項鍊的時機尚未到來。你得等到封印解除才行。哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF1個魔法鐵鏈
20個金塊
10個藍寶石
10個神之金屬
1個腰帶^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
不過，雷神腰帶的封印尚未解除。在那之前，你得等著！哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF3個未知的鋸齒輪子
5個天使翅膀羽毛
3個魚的靈魂
4個太陽神的象徵
3個靈魂的呼吸聲音
20個金塊
10個鋁
1雙帶孔靴子^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
但是即便如此，在封印解除之前，我也無法打造史雷普尼爾之靴。否則，你就只能自認倒霉了，人類。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF2個托爾的鐵手套
4個拷問器具
5個瓦爾基里的憤怒
5個暴風雨的徵兆
5個氣流
20個神之金屬
5個鋁
40個金塊
1個電擊棒^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
但是，如果封印還在，我連雷神之錘的複製品都無法打造。在封印解除之前，你就只能等著。哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我們矮人有著極高的自尊心，絕不會在低賤的人類面前展示我們的技藝！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
別煩我了，快滾出去！去跟那些魔物玩吧，你這個頭腦簡單的蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'll only present
my magnificent skills
to a human of incredibly
high standing!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我只會在地位極其崇高的人類面前，展示我精湛的技藝！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although I hate
most humans, I have
no choice but to respect the ones chosen by destiny. Go and bring your ^0000FFguildmaster^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
雖然我討厭大多數人類，但我別無選擇，只能尊重那些被命運選中的人。去把你的^0000FF公會會長^000000帶來！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although it is very humiliating to present my valuable skills to a human being...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
雖然向人類展示我寶貴的技藝是一件非常屈辱的事情...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
All the seals have been released, and he who holds the Emperium is chosen by destiny. I have no choice but to respect you.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
所有的封印都已解除，持有華麗金屬的人便是被命運選中的人。我別無選擇，只能尊重你。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
First of all, I shall confirm whether or not you have brought all the necessary materials to forge a godly item! I hate it when humans come here without any purpose!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
首先，我要確認你是否帶來了打造神器所需的所有材料！我最討厭那些毫無目的就來這裡的人類了！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFBrisingamen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF女神項鍊^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMegingjard^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF雷神腰帶^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFSleipnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF史雷普尼爾之靴^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMjolnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF雷神之錘^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......

[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......
.........

[Dwarf Grunburti]
How dare you come here unprepared?! Did you forget what you needed to bring? Listen carefully this time!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你竟敢毫無準備地來到這裡？！你忘了需要帶什麼了嗎？這次給我聽仔細了！

快一點...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmpf.
I can't get any work done in here. Come with me to the ^0000FFunderground laboratory^000000 as my guest, human.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
哼。
在這裡沒法幹活。跟我來^0000FF地下實驗室^000000吧，人類，作為我的客人。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now hurry up! ^0000FFOnly one of each godly item^000000 will be given to the humans ^FF0000right after all the seals are released^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
快一點！^0000FF每種神器只有一件^000000，會在^FF0000所有封印解除後^000000立即交給人類！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahahahaha!
Out of my sight,
you dirty, filthy
human...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
滾出我的視線，你這骯髒、汙穢的人類...

scripts.text:
[Entrance Notice]
Only the most
worthy of humans
will possess the
power of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[入口告示]
只有最優秀的人類才能擁有神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
One of the godly
items has been created,
and the seals have been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
一件神器已經制造完成，封印已經恢復。
你得等到它們再次被解除...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
布哇哈哈哈哈哈！
雖然你只是個人類，但我還是有點同情你~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How in the...
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
怎麼...
給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How did one of you
stupid humans get in
here?! Only those who
hold the Emperium can
even think of entering
this place...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你們這些愚蠢的人類是怎麼進來的？！
只有持有華麗金屬的人才能進入這裡...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
It's incredibly
humiliating to do work for a human. But since destiny has chosen you as the bearer of an Emperium, I have no choice but to oblige your requests.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
為人類幹活真是奇恥大辱。但既然命運選中了你作為華麗金屬的持有者，我別無選擇，只能滿足你的要求。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We only have
^FF000010 minutes^000000 to recreate one godly treasure. After that, the seals will restore themselves and I won't be able to create anything until they're released again...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我們只有^FF000010分鐘^000000的時間來重現一件神器。之後，封印會自行恢復，在封印再次解除之前，我無法制造任何東西...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^FF0000Don't be too slow^000000,
otherwise ^FF0000I will give
the chance to another
human^000000 right away!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^FF0000別太慢了^000000，否則我會^FF0000立刻把機會給另一個人類^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now...!
Choose the item
you wish for me
to create!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
現在...
選擇你希望我製造的物品！

[Dwarf Grunburti]
B-Brisingamen?!
I've never expected
such insolence...!
This necklace will never have any meaning in my eyes unless it's worn by the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
神...女神項鍊？！
我從未想過會有如此無禮的要求...
除非是女神芙蕾雅佩戴，否則這條項鍊在我眼中毫無意義。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But who am I to judge your worthiness? These treasures
select their owners with their own will. Let's see if Brisingamen will find you worthy!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
但我有什麼資格評判你的價值呢？這些寶物會憑自己的意志選擇主人。讓我們看看女神項鍊是否會認為你配得上它！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
再次，我需要以下材料來重現這件神器...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel

3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all

scripts.translation:

封印剛剛恢復。你得等到它們全部再次解除才行...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]

just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
布哇哈哈哈哈哈！
雖然你只是個人類，但我還是有點同情你~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]

[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
啊，看看這耀眼的美麗。沒有其他珠寶能像女神項鍊那樣完美地襯托芙蕾雅了。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!

everything I need to
recreate Brisingamen!

scripts.text:

you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:

史雷普尼爾...

穿上它們，以傳說史雷普尼爾的速度移動...

scripts.translation:

^333333*Sigh...*^000000
